title: Supplied coherent relative dualizing pair and its canonical class map
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a separated flat locally finitely presented morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-weil-flat-morphism], [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Put $Y=X\times_S X$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with first projection $p_1$ and diagonal $\Delta$. Let $A=\Delta_*\mathcal O_X$ be its ordinary direct-image algebra, and $A^\bullet=A[0]$ its degree-zero cochain complex [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Its multiplication is the unique chain map $t:\operatorname{Tot}(A^\bullet\otimes A^\bullet)\to A^\bullet$ sending $a\otimes b$ on the $(0,0)$ summand over every open $V\subset Y$ to the product $ab\in\mathcal O_X(\Delta^{-1}V)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. The canonical derived multiplication is $QA^\bullet\otimes^{\mathbf L} QA^\bullet\to Q\operatorname{Tot}(A^\bullet\otimes A^\bullet)\xrightarrow{Qt}QA^\bullet$, using the canonical lax monoidal localization map [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison] for [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. For $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], the scalar map $\mathcal O_X[0]\to R\mathcal Hom_X(K,K)$ is the transpose of the left unit action; for a map $\xi:QA^\bullet\to Lp_1^*K$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], multiplication by $\xi$ is the transpose of the composite of this derived multiplication with $\xi$, under the canonical tensor--Hom bijection [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection], with derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. The supplied pair $(K,\xi)$ is a coherent relative dualizing pair if $K$ is pseudo-coherent [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], every point has an open neighbourhood $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ such that $Lj^*K$ has finite Tor dimension over $S$ [def-pc-finite-tor-dimension-over], and multiplication by $\xi$ is an isomorphism $QA^\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_Y(QA^\bullet,Lp_1^*K)$. This is a predicate on supplied objects and classes, with no existence assertion.

proof.text: On every open of the fibre product, multiply sections of O_X on its inverse image under the diagonal. The two distributivity laws and commutativity make this bilinear for the structure-ring action. Restriction maps are ring homomorphisms, hence the products are natural. Apply the proved sheaf tensor bilinear universal property to obtain the unique ordinary multiplication m.

Identify the total tensor of the two degree-zero diagonal complexes with the single complex of their ordinary tensor. Use the proved source-library mapBifunctorSingle₁Iso and Mathlib singleMapHomologicalComplex. Compute its degree-zero tensor summand inclusion using mapBifunctorSingle₁XIso; it is the tensor of the single-object identity identifications. Compose this comparison with the single-complex map of m. The computed component proves the required product equation.

For uniqueness, a map to the degree-zero single complex is determined in degree zero. The total-tensor coproduct extensionality reduces equality there to summand inclusions. If the first index is nonzero, the source is zero because tensor preserves zero objects. Otherwise the second index is also zero, and uniqueness in the sheaf tensor bilinear universal property identifies the component. The original canonical derived multiplication then uses this now proved unique chain map; all other definitions are unchanged.
